Name: (AT CP DGA) RoseDryad's Fairydew Decorations
Author: RoseDryad
Description:
Items include mushroom fairy circles, mushroom stools, mushroom tables, baskets, benches, dressers, fairy outfit dressforms, small paintings, small birdbaths, mushroom tea sets, single rose vases, planter boxes, sunflower watering can planters, decorative witch hats, blankets, fairy houses, tiny fairy village, potted plants, mushroom stumps, mushroom log, flower beds, lattice panels, birdhouses, end tables, gardening tables, fairy offerings table, rugs, broomsticks, and beds. They all can be bought from Robin's.

I'll also be creating add-on mods to go along with this one.

You can see my progress on my [url=https://ko-fi.com/rosedryad]ko-fi[/url] and my to-do list is [url=https://ko-fi.com/Post/RoseDryads-Fairydew-Mod-To-Do-List-C0C7754XC]here[/url].

[b][u]Requirements:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url]﻿ *OPTIONAL for CP SDV version 1.6
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ *ONLY for AT SDV version 1.6
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url]* ONLY for DGA SDV version 1.5
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]
[/list]
[b][u]Notes about DGA - for SDV version 1.5:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]DGA has some [url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/issues]bugs[/url]﻿. I'm waiting for an update that fixes these issues.
[*]Decorations turn into chairs when placed on tables (DGA bug)
[*]Hats can't be worn, they are decorative only. (DGA has incomplete hat code)
[*]Beds may not layer correctly but they still work. (DGA bug)
[*]Not compatible with: CJB Item Spawner and stacking mods due to DGA having a different item system.
To spawn items, enter [font=Courier New]dga_store[/font] in the SMAPI console to open the DGA spawn menu.[/list]
[b][u]Notes about CP - for SDV version 1.6:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Beds are not functional, they are decorative only.
[/list]
[b][u]Recommended to use with:
[/u][/b][list]

[/list]
